verdict.rationale: Cal.com's API v2 documents a create-webhook endpoint. It takes a subscriberUrl, a customizable payload template, and a triggers enum covering booking lifecycle events (BOOKING_CREATED, PAID, RESCHEDULED, REQUESTED, CANCELLED, PAYMENT_INITIATED), and it works with OAuth via the EVENT_TYPE_WRITE scope. Zapier event automation is also offered as an alternative. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, docs on webhook signing/secret verification and retry behavior, and evidence of user- or org-level webhooks beyond the event-type-scoped endpoint.
